Product description

BEILUNER 24K Fountain Range

Excellent Writing Instrument

It's your good partner when you're working or creating. Document your work, and transcribe your creation.

Previous page

  1. Experience unprecedented confidence and style

    Delivers effortless, skip-free writing perfect for signatures, notes, or creative work.

  2. Executive Desk Statement Piece

    Whether signing contracts or journaling dreams, elevates every stroke into a excellence experience.

  3. Epitome of Luxury Writing

    Balanced weight distribution and comfortable grip ensure writing extended periods is a pleasure.

  4. Unrivaled Craftsmanship, Timeless Glamour

    Adopting BEILUNER's high-quality plating process, this pen exudes elegance and sophistication.

  5. Elegance in Every Detail

    Unique design and stylish appearance, stands out from the crowd, whether in the office or at home.

Next page

Luxury Pen Body-24K Gold Finish

Crafted from superior solid brass,accessorize with the extensive 24K Gold-plated body of the pen packs a punch, to bring luxurious texture.

High Quality Craftsmanship

Because every component has high precision requirements- making every part of the pen reveals a sense of refinement.

BEILUNER Brand Philosophy

Renowned for innovative design、craftsmanship, this pen embodies artisanal perfection for those who demand unparalleled sophistication.

Stunning gift

Celebrate special occasions with the BEILUNER Gold Metal Fountain Pen. Present it to someone special, and let them experience the joy of writing with this extraordinary piece of art, come with ink converter and six black cartridges!
